accounting.rationale: Mixed form-dependent properties and stream-transfer-only obligation are split.
Unformatted stream properties include position definitions and positioning/read/write permissions.
Out-of-order/gap/write/read permissions when positioning and READ permission exist.
Formatted stream properties mix record-marker effects, no-maximum rule, no-effect rule, processor-dependent positions, positioning permission, and control-character latitude.
Record markers impose formatted stream record structure.
Permission/latitude for presence or absence of a record marker at end of file.
No end marker makes the final record incomplete.
No-effect rule for empty no-marker record.
Positive position identity and first-position rule.
Processor-dependent successive-position relationship and validity of positive positions.
Permission to reposition to an inquired position if positioning is possible.
NOTE explains why an incomplete final record is not empty; it is not the basis for a requirement.
NOTE explains possible marker encodings and points to POS= inquiry; normative POS= behavior is elsewhere.
